title: IT Service Delivery Manager
summary: Makes sure an IT support or managed service meets its agreed service levels (SLAs) for a client or the business, using ITIL processes for incidents, problems and changes. Sits between the support teams, vendors and client leadership, owning service reviews, escalations and improvement plans.
dailyDuties: Review SLA and ticket reports from ServiceNow
Lead bridge calls and updates during major incidents
Chair change advisory boards and follow up problem records
Run monthly service reviews with clients
Handle client escalations and agree action plans
Plan shift cover and coach support team leads

skills.expectation: Run ITIL incident, request and service processes on a tool such as ServiceNow
Own SLAs and KPIs and run monthly service reviews with clients
Lead P1 bridge calls, updates and post-incident reviews
Run problem records and change advisory boards to closure
Hold vendors and partners to contracts and service levels
Build SLA and ticket reports for service reviews
Build SLA and ticket reports for service reviews
Manage client and business stakeholders and their escalations
Write clear incident updates and service review packs
Lead support teams across shifts and locations
Run service transition and improvement projects
Understand L2 and L3 support work well enough to challenge root causes

groups.label: A reporting tool (Excel or Power BI)

certifications.why: Most service delivery postings ask for ITIL Foundation
Helps with transition and improvement projects
